sections.title: Molecular profile of endometrial clear cell carcinoma
sections.intro: Clear cell is traditionally grouped with serous as "type II / high-risk histology". **Molecularly, it does not belong there.** All four classes occur, and no single class is a majority in every series.

notes.title: No randomized adjuvant evidence in clear cell carcinoma
notes.md:
- Every randomized row above enrolled clear cell by eligibility, but only GOG-122 reports a clear cell result (exploratory, 17 patients, CIs crossing 1), and clear cell was 3–10% of each trial. Treating stage I–II clear cell "like serous" in these trials was a design decision, not a finding. The molecular data argue against it.
- The SEER rows are the only clear-cell–specific adjuvant data. They show no disease-specific survival benefit from adjuvant therapy in stage I disease. They are uncontrolled, pre-molecular, and have no central pathology review — and with a 46% histotype confirmation rate on expert review [5], an unknown share of these "clear cell" cases were not clear cell at all.
- **Practical implication:** at stage I–II, molecular class (POLEmut → de-escalate; p53abn → intensify; MMRd → immunotherapy question) is a better-supported basis for adjuvant decisions than the clear cell label. NSMP clear cell is the gap: it is not favourable [1], and no trial addresses it.

notes.title: Interpretation traps
notes.md:
- **MMR status is the only usable modifier.** Only GOG-209 reports a clear cell outcome (OS HR 0.86, 0.43–1.76; n = 47, exploratory), but all the modern trials report dMMR vs pMMR. About 10–31% of clear cell tumours (more in mixed endometrioid/clear cell) are MMRd [1][3][7]. For those, the dMMR HRs (0.28–0.42) are the applicable result. For pMMR clear cell, the pMMR HRs are the nearest read-across but come overwhelmingly from endometrioid and serous patients.
- **Carbo/taxol is standard here by extrapolation**, not by any clear cell signal. GOG-209 non-inferiority was shown in a population with a small (3.5%) clear cell fraction.

sections.title: 3. Recurrent disease
sections.intro: Recurrent disease is **not one setting**. The GOG trials treated recurrence with first-line cytotoxic therapy in chemo-naive patients; the modern trials treat recurrence after platinum and increasingly after a checkpoint inhibitor. For clear cell, a further split matters: **pooled gynecologic clear cell trials** (mostly ovarian) versus **endometrial trials** (where clear cell is a small fraction).

notes.title: Why this split exists
notes.md: GOG-107, GOG-177 and GOG-209 all **excluded prior cytotoxic chemotherapy**. Their recurrent patients were chemo-naive. Reading their medians as salvage-line expectations overestimates what a pretreated patient can expect — GOG-209's own subgroups show median OS of 20.4–22.0 months in measurable/recurrent patients versus 113 months in the non-measurable, non-recurrent group.

notes.title: Reading notes
notes.md:
- **Count the endometrial patients, not the cohort.** Across the three pooled clear cell immunotherapy trials, endometrial primaries total **15** (LARA 3, MoST-CIRCUIT 4, DART 8). Known objective responses: **3 of 15** (MoST-CIRCUIT 2/4; DART 0/8; LARA 1/3). The cohort-level ORRs (40–54%) are ovarian results.
- **The same drugs gave opposite endometrial results.** Nivolumab/ipilimumab produced 2/4 responses at q3w induction dosing and 0/8 at q6w continuous dosing in more heavily pretreated patients. Neither denominator supports a conclusion.
- **The better-supported 2L routes are the all-histology ones:** lenvatinib/pembrolizumab (KEYNOTE-775, ~50 clear cell patients inside a positive trial) for pMMR, and PD-1 monotherapy for dMMR clear cell (GARNET type II ORR 47.6%). LARA supports lenvatinib/pembrolizumab across gynecologic clear cell, but with only 3 endometrial patients.
- **HER2 is an open question, not a gap to ignore.** About a quarter of ECCC may be FISH-amplified [9], clear cell was excluded from the only HER2 RCT (Fader), and DESTINY-PanTumor02 did not report histology. Test HER2 in recurrent ECCC; T-DXd evidence is tumour-agnostic, not clear-cell–specific.
- **Hormonal therapy is omitted:** clear cell is almost always ER-negative (8% ER+ after expert review [5]). This does not apply to tumours reclassified as endometrioid.
- The platinum-re-treatment row stays ⚠️: widely used practice that rests on extrapolation across the 3A/3B boundary.
